provenance.inheritance: Every numeric leaf, including array elements and metadata, inherits the nearest ancestor label and source, unless its object overrides them. ASSUMED is the root default. mechanismSources justify mechanisms only, never a hardware rating.
provenance.derived: Calculated values retain ASSUMED when any sizing input is assumed. Validation demonstrates arithmetic only, never playability or flight qualification.
provenance.unitConventions: mass kg; position/outline/zMin/zMax m (body frame x forward, y left, z up); intrinsicInertia* kg m^2 (about the part centre: intrinsicInertia about body z (yaw), intrinsicInertiaRoll about x, intrinsicInertiaPitch about y); power/heat/generatedPower W; energy J; time/delay s; temperature K; angle rad; thrust N; minimumImpulse N s; Isp s; dataRate byte/s; storage byte; sampleRate Hz; thermalCapacity J/K; conductance W/K; exposure fictional lattice-unit s. Counts, fractions and schema version are dimensionless. Suffixes override these conventions.

ship.name: Recursion return vehicle
ship.bodyFrame: x forward, y left, z up (right-handed); origin fixed to structure on the hull axis; positive yaw counterclockwise seen from +z, positive pitch raises the nose; positions are not COM-relative
ship.dryMassDefinition: Sum equipment, including crew, retained cabin consumables and tank dry hardware. Excludes propellant and fuel-cell reactants/product. Waste stays aboard; no silent mass loss.
ship.hullPolicy: Occupied volume is a union of convex prisms: the pressure hull (this outline, extruded over the 5 m body diameter) plus one thin prism per radiator and solar wing, whose outline is the appendage polygon at its current extension (configuration.appendages). No space between the parts is included. The antenna mast, camera, engine bell beyond x = -8 and RCS nozzles are not in the envelope.
ship.inertiaShapes: Intrinsic inertia about the centre of each part, body axes. intrinsicInertia is the 1C yaw (z) term, unchanged. habitat-structure: uniform solid cylinder of radius 2.5 m about x, so pitch = yaw and roll = m R^2 / 2. Radiator and solar wings: thin flat plates in the body x-y plane, so yaw = roll + pitch, split in the ratio span^2 : chord^2 of the stowed and deployed polygons and interpolated with extension. Every other assembly and every propellant: isotropic (sphere or compact box), roll = pitch = yaw.

buses.tie: Normally open, commanded close only after fault isolation; max transfer 6000 W.
Normally open, commanded close only after fault isolation; max transfer 6000 W.

buses.feedPolicy: OR-isolated dual feed; one converter supplies rated load, two do not double capacity; loss heat belongs to the supplying PDU.
Normally main-b; can transfer to main-a through isolated tie.

power.generationDispatch: Solar first, fuel cells follow residual demand, battery supplies remaining deficit. Curtail solar at full storage; no automatic dump heat. Charge only with real surplus, respecting limits. Dispatch per isolated bus first. Initial stacks start at zero output and ramp while the batteries bridge; no transient overgeneration. Transfer generation only across a healthy closed tie; reserve threshold inhibits optional loads, never the essential chain.
power.essentialFloorPolicy: Active life-support chain cannot be commanded off or automatically shed; substitute healthy spare first. Genuine shortage produces unmet demand and crew hazard, not invented power. Active actuator interruption is logged with achieved impulse.

rpc.resetPolicy: Latched open until deliberate reset after fault clears; no reset of dose, capacity loss or burnout. Fast trips integrate fractional-step fault energy.

power.branchRatingPolicy: Load RPC rating = max mode input / branch bus voltage * branchHeadroom. Source contactor rating = max generatedPower / source bus voltage * branchHeadroom, bidirectional battery contactor uses max(chargePower, dischargePower). PDU/converter feeder ratings derive from bus maxPower, not housekeeping load.

solar.formula: min(maxPower, irradiance * area * efficiency * max(0, arrayNormal dot lightDirection) * deployment * condition); zero in shadow. arrayNormal is a body-frame unit vector: the wings are feathered about their span (body y) to face forward, as the planar model assumed. Irradiance is measured environment input, not inferred from fictional gravity.
solar.initialPolicy: Unknown illumination is conservatively zero until measured; arrays stowed initially.

fuelCell.formula: hydrogenDot=P/(efficiencyHHV*HHV); oxygenDot=8*hydrogenDot; productDot=9*hydrogenDot; heat=P*(1/efficiencyHHV-1). HHV reference closes energy with retained liquid water; includes condensation heat in this effective model. P is net bus output, auxiliaries already included.
fuelCell.productPolicy: Store product in product-water tank. Full tank or either exhausted reactant stops stack. No electrolyser in this baseline, no free refill.

battery.formula: E_dot=etaCharge*P_charge-P_discharge/etaDischarge; Q=P_charge*(1-etaCharge)+P_discharge*(1/etaDischarge-1). Never charge and discharge same pack concurrently.

thermalNodes.note: Local water-side temperature, not cabin air. Warning/failure here are lower bounds; dwell rule determines rupture.

thermalLoops.policy: One active pump sufficient. Regulated bypass limits transfer to avoid freezing water at the exchanger; disabled flow plus disabled heater in a cold soak can still freeze. Freeze rupture latched; restart does not repair. Thermostatic flow/bypass regulates source node at its control target; Q_transfer=min(conductance*max(T_source-T_sink,0),maxHeatTransport,max(0,Q_source+controlGain*(T_source-T_target))). When source is colder, retain signed passive conduction; failed-open regulation allows signed forced conduction and water freeze risk. Radiator rejection also requires external-pump flow.

Shared cold-plate loop serves service electronics, fuel cells and two radiator branches. Two pumps are spares, not independent loops; common leak defeats both. Isolating one radiator preserves other branch. Thermostatic flow/bypass regulates source node at its control target; Q_transfer=min(conductance*max(T_source-T_sink,0),maxHeatTransport,max(0,Q_source+controlGain*(T_source-T_target))). When source is colder, retain signed passive conduction; failed-open regulation allows signed forced conduction and water freeze risk. Radiator rejection also requires external-pump flow.

radiators.formula: Q=epsilon*sigma*A_emit*viewFactor*(T^4-T_sink^4)-alpha*irradiance*A_projected; A_emit includes both emitting faces. A_projected is one-sided geometric planform times max(0, arrayNormal dot lightDirection), the same incidence as the solar wings. Pointing changes absorbed light and obstruction/view factors, not an arbitrary cosine to empty space.
radiators.statePolicy: Deployment and pointing are distinct continuous states. Stalled motor freezes geometry. No heat rejection from cabin/service through a stalled pump except declared passive conductance.
radiators.louverPolicy: Thermostatic louvers reduce effective IR emission; target external-loop temperature with continuously bounded opening. Radiation formula multiplied by louverEmissionFraction on emitted IR only, not on absorbed light. A jam preserves last opening. Initial fraction balances arrival steady heat at target, batteries bridge stack startup. Louvers and branch isolation are included in radiator assembly mass. This is an assumed lumped control model, not an ISS louver claim.

configuration.interpolation: Linear extension of centroid and polygon vertices; the three intrinsic inertia terms interpolated as a simplified rail deployment, not a detailed hinge model. Each wing is a thin prism (zMin..zMax) over its current polygon. Preserve angular momentum as I changes; actuator energy is charged.

main.policy: Pressure-fed storable bipropellant represented by one mixture-locked tank; on/off or pulse train, no arbitrary deep throttle. Two-axis gimbal (yaw about body z, pitch about body -y; gimbalLimit and gimbalRate apply to each axis) aims through current COM if in range; output force at mount. mountMisalignment is about body +z (tilts thrust toward +y), mountMisalignmentPitch about body -y (tilts thrust toward +z). Exhaust carries most chemical energy, not bus power.

rcs.bankPolicy: A active initially, B isolated unpowered spare. Each bank contains the same twenty directions (five per pod: nozzles fore, aft, up, down and outboard; the force on the ship is opposite the nozzle); share propellant/cooling/structure. Switching requires power, warm state and calibration; never restores dose or clogs.
rcs.bankThermalApproximation: In the initial node model, both banks share their pod's service-node temperature. Minimum readiness time is a valve/ignition checkout, with heating only when below warmupTemperature. An unpowered spare is not assumed physically cold when its surroundings are warm. Independent cold nozzle behavior requires local thermal states in Phase3; do not invent a cold temperature in the stub.

attitudeControl.label: ASSUMED
attitudeControl.policy: Flight-software play values. Per body axis: commanded rate = attitudeGain * (attitude error beyond attitudeDeadband), its magnitude limited to slewRate; no torque is asked while the rate error is inside rateDeadband; otherwise angular acceleration = rateGain * rate error, turned into torque with the full inertia tensor and into jet firings by the allocator (least propellant, at most maxSimultaneousJetsPerPod per pod, whole minimum impulse bits). handsOnTurnRate is the body rate a full yaw or pitch deflection asks for. torquePriority weights a missed torque against a missed force when both cannot be met.

ion.policy: Optional full-power/off long-coast capability. Force and Isp retain S08 reference operating point; no encounter-scale boost. Heat is a conservative assumed allocation, not source-measured bus dissipation.

camera.formula: sigmaAngle=max(floor, nominal*sqrt(referencePower/clamp(P,min,max))*sqrt(referenceExposure/exposure))/condition; transverse sigma=range*sigmaAngle. The pointing error is isotropic: elevation sigma=sigmaAngle, azimuth sigma=sigmaAngle/cos(elevation). The field of view is a cone of half-angle fovHalfAngle about the boresight. Reject when abs(angularRate)*exposure exceeds maxSmearAngle, target absent, or optics invalid. No measurement below minimum power. Range sigma=max(rangeFloor,rangePriorFraction*range) only for a declared known-size/shape target; otherwise bearing-only until triangulation. Reject condition<=0; otherwise condition must be clamped to (0,1]. sigma is only for valid targets with adequate signal; low-light invalidity is separate. Clamp commanded exposure to [minExposure,maxExposure] before evaluating quality or smear.
camera.policy: Power changes frame processing/exposure duty; never grants target identity, absolute range or visibility through an occluder. Dark scenes can fail even at full power. Camera raw frames optional, no truth-state storage.

starTracker.catalogPolicy: No assumed Earth-catalog match. Bootstrap a local relative star map if stars visible; choose an arbitrary inertial frame. Lost solutions increase covariance, no perfect attitude fallback.
starTracker.fixPolicy: A fix is the body-to-inertial attitude with an independent error of angularSigma about each body axis, reported as a rotation vector. No fix while the magnitude of the angular velocity exceeds maxAngularRate.

imu.policy: Specific force only (P7), three body axes, each with its own bias (accelerationBias) and noise; three-axis rate gyro likewise (gyroBias, gyroSigma). Gravity comes from tracking. Correct lever-arm angular acceleration/centripetal terms to COM using measured attitude rates; keep correction uncertainty. Bias and noise are measured-model assumptions, seeded streams only.

latticeProcessing.label: FICTIONAL
latticeProcessing.policy: Additional software on existing hardware; no new sensor, no hidden truth channel to the ordinary forecaster. Use imperfect reconstruction measurements and their uncertainties. Reconstruction does not shield components.

recorder.fullPolicy: Stop optional raw frames then high-rate telemetry; preserve command/configuration/fault metadata in reserved capacity; if reservation fills, stop new records with visible warning. No silent overwrite. Never alter previously issued forecasts. Record sample packets select timestamped features from offered equipment streams, not every raw output byte. Optional raw frames add rawFrameRateBytes to storage and require camera detail plus science processing mode.

persistence.label: FICTIONAL
persistence.policy: P8 recurrence retains all acquired records and knowledge. Capacity limits new onboard acquisition during an attempt, never erases prior attempt archives. Recorder power loss causes gaps, not loss of already recorded data. Survival across recurrence is not conventional hardware reliability.

communications.policy: No authenticated receiver/link initially; actual downlink is zero until measured endpoint, geometry, pointing and link margin support it. Rated rate is an assumed ceiling, not a distance-independent promise. RF output leaves ship; remaining electrical draw heats service node.

lifeSupport.policy: Stored-gas and replaceable sorbent survival mode; no oxygen electrolyser or water recycler simulated. Consumables are subsets of cabin-stores equipment mass, not extra dry mass. Consumed mass becomes retained atmosphere/waste. Active scrubber consumes finite sorbent capacity; loss accumulates cabin CO2. Hazard budget is an assumed simplified inventory alarm, not medical physiology. Fuel-cell oxygen is separate, not available to crew by default.

radiation.label: FICTIONAL
radiation.dosePolicy: Each component integrates local intensity * susceptibility * dt at its moving occupied geometry; off equipment still accumulates. Spatial sampling and sweep resolution are field-owner responsibilities; never use only ship COM.
radiation.algorithm: Use integrated-exposure integer bucket crossings for upsets/latches while energized, advancing bucket cursors while off so no backlog fires at power-on. Protected SEL trips local branch; excess electrical input becomes heat until isolation. For powered components, integrate contiguous time above profile burnoutIntensity (raw local intensity); crossing burnoutDwell causes irreversible failure even with protection. FailureExposure causes irreversible failure regardless of power. Degradation increases leakage linearly from degradationStart to failureExposure; multiply operating draw by 1+maxLeakageFraction*clamp((D-start)/(failure-start),0,1), with extra draw as heat. Resolve competing events in time order, failures before trips before upsets for exact ties. Preserve D and permanent states on reset.
radiation.abstraction: Dose-like degradation imitates cumulative ionizing damage; deterministic upset/latch buckets imitate single-event outcomes but are not physical SEE probability or TID causation. Material-selective harm to electronics with no modeled acute crew dose is fictional. Real SEU need not damage hardware; real current limiting cannot guarantee survival.
radiation.geometryPolicy: Compact assemblies use their moving mount point as a declared approximation; appendages use their whole current polygon, taking the maximum local intensity conservatively. Structure/crew/passive tanks have zero susceptibility in this selective fictional model. Collision geometry still covers the full envelope. Phase3 field integrator must sweep between samples to avoid skipping thin strands.

thermalProtection.label: ASSUMED
thermalProtection.policy: Equipment temp is attached node temp in the stub, including cooling dependencies; labels refer to assembly/cold-plate temperature, not plume gas. Begin derating above tempMax-derateMargin; latch electrical overtemp trip at tempMax. Uncooled residual heat above tempMax+damageMargin for damageDwell causes permanent failure; deliberately retained history prevents cooling from healing damage. Electronics below tempMin unavailable until warmed. Passive structure/tanks/crew use hazard state rather than electrical trip. If water-side exchanger stays below freezeTemperature with no protecting flow/heater for freezeRuptureDwell, latch rupture; rates are deliberately simplified, not component qualification data. Low-temperature inhibition applies to normal operation, not to commanded antifreeze or warmup heaters while intact and powered; otherwise cold equipment could never recover. Heater overtemperature and permanent-damage protections still apply.

thermalLinks.policy: External pump moves ammonia past core even if internal water pump stalls. Regulated ammonia bypass holds hx-water target; failed-open bypass uses signed conductance*(T_core-T_external), allowing cold soak below water freezing. Antifreeze mode of interface-hx adds its declared heater power only when powered. Cabin-to-core heat collapses to passive conductance if internal pump stops. This separate local state is required for Phase3 freeze behavior; Phase2 may collapse it only while explicitly deferring freeze simulation.
